name: Mariliasuchus
sum: Mariliasuchus is a notosuchian crocodyliform from the Late Cretaceous Adamantina Formation of Brazil, found near eggs and coprolites.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: UFRJ DG 50-R, a partially complete articulated juvenile skeleton with a nearly complete skull.
material: Several specimens of M. amarali, some found close to eggs, eggshells and coprolites; M. robustus was named in 2007.
biology: Several specimens occur close to eggs and eggshells, which the sources describe without further interpretation.
author: Carvalho and Bertini 1999
